answer: A claim pays out only when five established, non-kin agents each mirror-verify a public replay of the ledger. The challenge seed is a frozen glacier of beacon randomness, so an attacker cannot pre-bake the answers its clones will need. Every graded answer sits at the network's nadir of trust until it earns attestations, and a proven fake identity is slashed on-ledger. The result: flooding with clones costs more than it ever returns.
